twoFactor.manualEntry: Can't scan? Enter this key instead

twoFactor.recoveryDescription: Each code works once. If you lose your phone, these are the only way back into your account — we cannot show them again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my account
deleteAccount.description: Permanently deletes your Atlas account. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.consequenceIrreversible: Your name, email address and profile are permanently removed. The account cannot be restored.
deleteAccount.consequenceSessions: You are signed out everywhere immediately, and you will not be able to sign in again.
deleteAccount.consequenceAcademies: Any academy you own is archived, which takes its public website offline.
deleteAccount.consequenceRecords: Records that must be kept — billing history, audit entries, and content you posted — remain, but are no longer linked to you by name.
deleteAccount.confirmDescription: This is irreversible. Please confirm you want to delete your Atlas account.
